name: Product Description on Shop & Archive Pages for WooCommerce
author: hulkplugins

sections.description:
Display short product descriptions on shop, category, and other listing pages to increase customer interest and encourage visits to product pages.

Product Overview

Documentation

Video Overview

Features

  • Easy to use
  • Show product descriptions on all archive pages or specific shop, tag, and category pages.
  • Choose to position the description either before or after:
    • Product Title
    • Product Price
    • Product Rating
    • Add-to-cart Button
  • Show a short description of related products as well
  • Show content from “Product Short”, “Product Detail”, or custom “Loop” description
  • Set the word limit for the product description
  • Customize text alignment, font size, and color
  • WooCommerce Compatible

Note: This is the free version of the plugin. Some advanced features are available in the Pro version.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation from the WordPress Dashboard

  1. Login to your admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins -> Add New
  3. Search Product Description on Shop & Archive Pages for WooCommerce
  4. Click install and activate respectively.

Manual Installation from the WordPress Dashboard

If your server is not connected to the Internet, then you can use this method

  1. Download the plugin. A ZIP file will be downloaded.
  2. Login to your site\’s admin panel and navigate to Plugins -> Add New -> Upload.
  3. Click choose file, select the plugin file and click install

Install Using FTP

If you are unable to use any of the methods due to internet connectivity and file permission issues, then you can use
this method

  1. Download the plugin. A ZIP file will be downloaded.
  2. Unzip the file.
  3. Launch your favorite FTP client. Such as FileZilla, FireFTP, CyberDuck etc. If you are a more advanced user, then you
    can use SSH too.
  4. Upload the folder to wp-content/plugins/
  5. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  6. Navigate to Plugins -> Installed
  7. Activate the plugin
sections.faq:
Is there a word limit for the listing page description?

No! There is no word limit; you can add as long a description as you like, but considering the size of a product listing, we recommend keeping the description under 3 lines for better visibility!

Does this plugin work with classic WooCommerce pages?

No. This plugin is designed specifically for modern WooCommerce block-based pages.
